posts.title: Keepup: I handed my agent setup maintenance to the agent itself
posts.description: My coding agent setup is a pile of skills, MCP servers, plugins, hooks, and helper CLIs, each with its own update path and its own way of quietly going stale. I audited it by hand for far too long before it occurred to me that the agent could do the audit, so I wrote keepup, an open-source Agent Skill that inventories the setup, checks every item against its source, and applies only the fixes I ap

posts.title: Gold & Skulls: I rebuilt a lost 2011 mobile game as a premium Android roguelike
posts.description: Gold & Skulls 1.1.0 is out on Google Play: a turn-based chain-matching puzzle roguelike with 10 classes, 40 skills, 32 special skulls, and no ads, no in-app purchases, no account, and no tracking.

posts.title: vincent 0.12.0: issues, handoffs, and GitHub Copilot after the three-pillar refactor
posts.description: The first vincent release built on the intake, workshop and handoff split: issues vincent owns and syncs from GitHub, one line of work per issue, handoffs with human grants, GitHub Copilot CLI as a fourth agent, and an end-to-end workflow that uses all of it.
